description: This file defines the NvramConfig class and its nested InstanceSpecific class, which manage with configurations related to modem simulation, including methods for initialization, access, serialization, and per-instance configuration details.

classes.name: NvramConfig
classes.description: Class managing modem simulator configuration data, including multiple instances and settings, with serialization and file I/O functionalities.

classes.name: NvramConfig::InstanceSpecific
classes.description: Nested class representing the configuration for a specific modem instance with parameters such as network mode, operator, and emergency mode.

methods.name: InitNvramConfigService
methods.description: Initializes the NVRAM configuration service for a given number of instances and SIM type.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the NvramConfig.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the current configuration state to a file (static method).

methods.name: NvramConfig
methods.description: Constructor for creating a config object with specified number of instances and SIM type.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Move assignment operator for NvramConfig.

methods.name: ConfigFileLocation
methods.description: Returns the path to the configuration file location.

methods.name: SaveToFile (const std::string& file) const
methods.description: Serializes and writes the configuration object to the specified file.

methods.name: ForInstance
methods.description: Returns configuration details specific to a given instance number.

methods.name: Instances
methods.description: Returns a vector of all instance-specific configuration objects.

methods.name: sim_type
methods.description: Returns the SIM type for the current configuration.
